shots.name: RW-01-village-from-the-south
shots.note: The road from Helgen, the village and its roofs ahead. research-055's measured eye position (ground + 120).

shots.name: RW-02-street-to-the-inn
shots.note: The street north-east: the Riverwood Trader on the right, the Sleeping Giant Inn ahead.

shots.name: RW-03-trader-front
shots.note: The Riverwood Trader's front and its hanging sign, looking back south down the street.

shots.name: RW-04-inn-front
shots.note: The Sleeping Giant Inn's front, its sign and the walkway. The pitch is steep because the eye stands above the inn's terrace.

shots.name: RW-05-mill-wheel-across-the-river
shots.note: The lumber mill's water wheel, the mill and the rapids across the water, 1763 units away. The route's finale.

shots.name: RW-06-river-to-the-bridge
shots.note: North along the river to Bridge01 at (24283,-39517), 4436 units away. No UESP reference: this is an engine-only view of the ring's distant terrain.

shots.name: RW-07-village-from-the-south-hill
shots.note: The whole village from Faendal's doorstep, looking north.

shots.name: RW-08-guardian-stones
shots.note: The three Guardian Stones on their bluff, 1563 units away, about 315 m south-west of the village.

shots.name: RW-09-inn-common-room
shots.note: Inside the Sleeping Giant Inn from its own door's XTEL arrival point. A proposal: the arrival heading is -0.0084 rad, so yaw 0 is the door's own facing. Refine by rendering.

shots.name: RW-10-trader-shop-floor
shots.note: Inside the Riverwood Trader from its door's arrival point. A proposal; refine by rendering.

shots.name: RW-11-alvors-house
shots.note: Inside Alvor and Sigrid's House from its door's arrival point (the arrival z is 240, plus the 120 eye). A proposal; refine by rendering.

shots.name: RW-12-faendals-house
shots.note: Inside Faendal's House from its door's arrival point (arrival z -16, plus the 120 eye). Not on the walking route, but it has a reference. A proposal; refine by rendering.
